items.text: Indianapolis CB Sauce Gardner (calf), TE Tyler Warren (groin), CB Justin Walley (knee), G Matt Goncalves (ankle) and TE Drew Ogletree did not practice Wednesday. WR Alec Pierce is on IR.

Minnesota (off a Week 6 bye): Justin Jefferson (ankle) and RT Brian O'Neill limited Wednesday; Jordan Addison, T.J. Hockenson and Christian Darrisaw full, and RB Jordan Mason was designated to return from IR. Kyler Murray is healthy.

adjust.reason: Indianapolis may be without both starting cornerbacks, a starting guard and its top tight ends while Minnesota is getting healthy off its bye. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
